label: Blind sample burn 006: MTBS Rock fire, CA, 2019-06-25

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.38 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 25 Jun 2019 (90% interval −0.40 to −0.35). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02).

evidence.sentence: Optical and radar agree: burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.38 and radar backscatter (VH) fell by 1.6 dB (combined placebo p = 0.03).
